One of the easiest digital products to create is a shortcut to a problem people are already trying to solve. Think: A checklist. A swipe file. A template. A mini planner. A step-by-step cheat sheet. Instead of asking: “What digital product should I make?” Ask: “What is my audience repeatedly struggling to figure out?” Then package the answer into something that helps them do it faster, easier, or with less guesswork. Example: If your audience struggles with what to post → create a 30-Day Content Prompt Pack. You don’t need to create something huge.
